summary: Cape Mountain, Lane County OR: L-4 cab built 1933 near Florence; moved to Heceta Beach in 1951 (one source says destroyed 1950); site today not described.

facts.status_note: Cab moved off the peak in 1951 per the register and Forest Lookouts; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1950; no remains described

events.note: L-4 cab built on the peak; a forest road to the mountain was under construction in 1932
Floyd Fisk transferred from Prairie Mountain to Cape Mountain as a fire precaution
Donald Johnson at the station in 1935 and again in May 1936
Mapleton district ranger organized airplane observation posts; Cape Mountain was one of the posts established
Ernest Ready and wife resigned; relieved by Walter and Mrs. Dennis of Clatskanie
firelookout.com says Destroyed 1950; the register and Forest Lookouts say moved in 1951
Lookout house purchased by a private party and moved to Heceta Beach, used as a weekend cabin; Forest Lookouts says moved to a private site on Heceta Beach Road
Registered September 23, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Forest Lookouts both say the cab was moved to Heceta Beach in 1951. firelookout.com says it was destroyed in 1950. The story reports both and does not pick one as settled.

notes_for_editor: Gone lookout on the Siuslaw NF. Brief record had only the 2010 FFLOS registration; added the 1933 build, the 1935-43 staffing and the fate. The fate conflicts (1950 destroyed vs 1951 moved) are unresolved and both are reported. The NGS station note is cited from the Forest Lookouts page, not the NGS site itself; it says the station is at the highest point, not what remains. Used 1 WebSearch and about 5 page reads.
